integrity: The universal proof is symbolic. A standalone exact-rational verifier checks every finite logarithmic sign used for the order-8 cutoff and the comparison with Corollary 3.10. No finite computation is used as a substitute for the universal induction.
scientific_limitations: The endpoint \(89\) is exact for the adjacent-prime bootstrap certificate at order \(8\), not an assertion that \(97\) can be absent. The argument assumes exactly the increasing-concave abscissa hypotheses of Musin's Theorem 3.9 and does not optimize higher-exponent or non-adjacent forcing paths.
title: Prime-support bootstrapping for higher-order colossally abundant contacts
